targetTexts.1: I commend to you our sister Phoebe, a servant of the church in Cenchrea.
targetTexts.2: Welcome her in the Lord in a manner worthy of the saints, and assist her with anything she may need from you. For she has been a great help to many people, including me.
targetTexts.3: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,
targetTexts.4: who have risked their lives for me. Not only I but all the churches of the Gentiles are grateful to them.
targetTexts.5: Greet also the church that meets at their house. Greet my beloved Epenetus, who was the first convert to Christ in the province of Asia.
targetTexts.6: Greet Mary, who has worked very hard for you.
targetTexts.7: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my fellow countrymen and fellow prisoners. They are outstanding among the apostles, and they were in Christ before I was.
targetTexts.8: Greet Ampliatus, my beloved in the Lord.
targetTexts.9: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and my beloved Stachys.
targetTexts.10: Greet Apelles, who is approved in Christ. Greet those who belong to the household of Aristobulus.
targetTexts.11: Greet Herodion, my fellow countryman. Greet those from the household of Narcissus who are in the Lord.
targetTexts.12: Greet Tryphena and Tryphosa, women who have worked hard in the Lord. Greet my beloved Persis, who has worked very hard in the Lord.
targetTexts.13: Greet Rufus, chosen in the Lord, and his mother, who has been a mother to me as well.
targetTexts.14: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers with them.
targetTexts.15: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas and all the saints with them.
targetTexts.16: Greet one another with a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ send you greetings.
targetTexts.17: Now I urge you, brothers, to watch out for those who create divisions and obstacles that are contrary to the teaching you have learned. Turn away from them.
targetTexts.18: For such people are not serving our Lord Christ, but their own appetites. By smooth talk and flattery they deceive the hearts of the naive.
targetTexts.19: Everyone has heard about your obedience, so I rejoice over you. But I want you to be wise about what is good and innocent about what is evil.
targetTexts.20: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
targetTexts.21: Timothy, my fellow worker, sends you greetings, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my fellow countrymen.
targetTexts.22: I, Tertius, who wrote down this letter, greet you in the Lord.
targetTexts.23: Gaius, who has hosted me and all the church, sends you greetings. Erastus, the city treasurer, sends you greetings, as does our brother Quartus.
